output.title: New flag enables annotation copying for Ingress and Gateway resources
output.content: This change adds a --extra-certificate-annotations controller flag to copy annotations from Ingress or Gateway resources to Certificate objects. This feature is optionally available to any cert-manager deployment using Ingress or Gateway-based certificate automation. The environment runs cert-manager with HTTP challenge role configuration, consistent with Ingress-based automation. If you use Ingress or Gateway resources for certificate provisioning, you can enable this feature.
